title: Blueberry Cream Ice Pops
changes_from_base: Briefly cooked blueberries blended with condensed milk, cream and soured cream replace the strawberry purée and jam.
summary: Creamy ice pops with bursts of cooked blueberry running through a soured cream and condensed milk base.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook 290 g blueberries with 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp caster sugar and ¼ tsp salt over medium heat, stirring, for 4-5 min until the berries burst (2-4 min longer if using frozen).

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool for 10 min in the processor bowl.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the mixture for 30-60 s until smooth.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Add 120 ml condensed milk, blend for 20-30 s and scrape down the sides.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Add 240 ml double cream and process for 1-2 min until slightly thick.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add 60 ml soured cream and 1 tsp vanilla and blend for 30-60 s more.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pour into ten 80 ml moulds just under the rim, add the sticks and freeze for at least 8 h.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Run warm water over the moulds to release the pops.

tips: Cook the blueberries until they fully burst so the fruit blends smoothly into the cream base.
Cool the cooked blueberries before blending in the condensed milk and cream, or the mixture may separate.
Leave a little space at the rim of each mould, as the mixture expands slightly as it freezes.
storage: Keep the pops in their moulds or wrapped individually in the freezer.
